content.title: Chapter 2
content.subtitle: Policy and Regulatory Framework
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the first chapter of the Just Energy Transition Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.

nextBlock.title: Chapter 3: Inclusive and Effective Institutions
nextBlock.cta: Inclusive and effective institutions are the cornerstone of robust governance systems, ensuring coordinated efforts for a just energy transition. This section explores the roles of key actors, multi-level governance, and the importance of transparency, trust, and anti-corruption measures in energy governance.
